## Biography

Nones is a system in independent space, the departure point on the Independent Detention Foundation's four-system prisoner transit route. In September 3312, the Riker-class Reformatory EVE-597 jumped from Nones bound for Gliese 506.2 and failed to arrive, with no debris found along the route.
